Medical Natural Sciences

Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam

← Back to search
About this programme

UCR currently cannot construct a sufficiently close programme for a meaningful curriculum comparison.

VU Medical Natural Sciences brings physics, chemistry, mathematics and computing together with physiology to investigate disease and medical technology. Students learn experimental measurement, molecular analysis and modelling before completing an individual research project.

UCR offers substantial biomedical science, molecular laboratory work, mathematics and image/data analysis. The available courses do not establish a complete programme organised around the physical and chemical principles of medical measurement and technology. We therefore show the verified VU curriculum without presenting a UCR programme as a comparable alternative.

Academic year: 2026–2027

External pathway: Common major; Machine Learning selected from the compulsory choice

The 180 EC pathway contains 60 EC in each year, including 30 EC open study and an 18 EC individual research project. The restricted 6 EC choice is not a specialisation. Language, lab-safety and career-study requirements add no credits; project entry, elective-level and approval conditions apply. Clinical-physics certification and training have additional requirements.
